title: The Road to Oz
author: L. Frank (Lyman Frank) Baum
longDescription: Frank Baum is a children’s fantasy novel written in the early 20th century. This enchanting tale follows Dorothy Gale, her loyal dog Toto, the Shaggy Man, Button Bright, and Polychrome, the Rainbow's Daughter, as they embark on a whimsical adventure along an enchanted road that leads to the Marvelous Land of Oz.

authorInfo.bio: L. Frank (Lyman Frank) Baum (1856–1919) is the author of The Road to Oz. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
